Most people see this place only as the residence of Wizards, but you might be surprised to learn how many non-mystics make their home here as well. merchant/30163-1.htm.text: Merchant Rex: I'm not sure if we have what you're looking for. Tell me again...

merchant/30163-pk.htm.text: Merchant Rex: You are very lucky today. If I were a younger man I would have picked up the sharpest sword and killed you with it. Now get lost! You are not welcome here!
